text: The Claude adapter v0.101.0 starts a new session in Claude Code's `auto` permission mode when settings give no `permissions.defaultMode` (`resolveInitialPermissionMode` in its `src/session-mode.ts`). In `auto` the agent does not send `session/request_permission` for actions Claude Code judges safe, so coax shows no permission box for them. Jack's settings set no `defaultMode`. Checked 2026-11-09 with a `session/new`: `currentModeId` was `auto`.
